text:
alex: Quick heads-up: while triaging a support ticket I found a broken anchor redirect from an external blog -> /docs/guides/kv-cache.md#tips. It 404s.

nina: Can you paste the exact link? I can grep the repo.

alex: Sure: https://docs.redwood.ai/guides/kv-cache.md#tips

link-bot: :warning: link-scan: unreachable anchor detected in guides/kv-cache.md (#tips) referenced by docs/blog/2026-01-kv-tips.md (severity: medium)

sam: OK - two fixes: update the blog link to the new anchor (#best-practices) and add a redirect_from for the old shortlink on guides/kv-cache.md so external links keep working.

priya: I can open the PR. Small checklist: update blog, add frontmatter alias to guides/kv-cache.md, run local link-check, add a one-liner in changelog if it's customer-visible.

nina: Also grep for other /guides/kv shortlinks in the repo before merging. I ran a quick search: 
```
$ git grep -n "/guides/kv" -- docs blog || true
docs/blog/2026-01-kv-tips.md:32: /guides/kv-cache.md#tips
docs/old_notes/kv-legacy.md:10: /guides/kv-cache.md#tips
```

priya: Thanks. I'll update both spots and include a tiny test in docs/link-check/tests/test_aliases.py to assert /guides/kv-cache resolves.

link-bot: PR created by priya: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5233 — title: "fix(docs): restore legacy kv anchor + update blog links"

alex: Ping me for review, I'll sanity-check the preview build.

priya: CI passed, preview deployed at https://deploy-preview-5233.docs.redwood.ai/. Pushed small test and frontmatter: 
```
---
redirect_from:
  - /guides/kv
---
```

sam: LGTM, approved. Merged by alex (2876543248).

priya: Closing loop — support confirmed the external blog link now resolves. I'll schedule a short sweep next week to find other legacy guide anchors.

(automated) link-bot: weekly-scan: anchors for guides/kv-cache.md OK.
